heading: 9. Conformance
text: 9. Conformance

heading: 9. Conformance
text: A conforming implementation of this hash profile MUST construct canonical hash inputs and payloads according to Sections 6 and 7, encode them using the Logos deterministic CBOR profile required by LOGOS-MODULE-INTERFACE Section 4.4, and apply `logos.hash-suite.blake3-256` exactly as defined in Section 6.1.

heading: 9. Conformance
text: It MUST reject malformed hash inputs, unknown identifiers, wrong digest lengths, wrong domain tags, non-canonical CBOR encodings, and mismatched domain-to-payload shapes as described by this specification.

heading: 9. Conformance
text: It MUST produce the Appendix A schema-root vector and every Appendix B physical-layout digest exactly.

heading: 9. Conformance
text: A verified-view implementation MUST accept the valid Appendix B views and reject mutations that change a disclosed value, path, range, label, count, schema identity, node kind, child digest, payload discriminator, domain tag, step order, or expected value root.
